verdict.rationale: BigQuery is an API-driven cloud service, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack mentions the Storage Write API (gRPC/REST), SDKs, a CLI, ODBC/JDBC drivers and an MCP server. None of these items documents a downloadable OpenAPI spec, discovery document, or published protobuf definitions, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.
